findings.reason: as written the new refusal fails an honest manifest for quoting the defect it describes, which is the failure class the plan exists to remove; the trigger needs narrowing (and a tenth case for a quoted arm in prose) before a worker implements it.
findings.text: §8's second deliverable refuses any manifest "field whose value contains `baseline_suite:` or `after_suite:` followed by `{`, while that key has no line of its own", without narrowing to the shape the defect actually took — a key glued onto the tail of prose with no separator. The reproduced defect reads `…not resolved herebaseline_suite: {"revision": …}`, but the same rule also matches prose that *quotes* an arm. Measured over the plan's own census population (14,221 `manifest.md` files under `r-202610*/` and `r-202611*/`): one honest manifest is caught — `~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261107T142430888015-plan-review-of-a-promotion-reads-the-evidence-it-is-given/manifest.md` line 16, whose `evidence_inputs` reads "…line 33 glues baseline_suite: { onto blockers prose", and which has no `baseline_suite:` line of its own, so it would be refused at parse while its evidence is exactly correct. The done-when's seventh case tests only a mention with *no* object after the key, so no case covers a quoted arm and nothing catches the over-reach.

findings.reason: the census exists to show the widened rule does not break honest manifests, and a single arm makes its two headline figures unsound, so the section must instruct a base arm (or name the base refusal count) before the evidence can support the rule.
findings.text: the census tells the worker to run "the new `reports.py` reader" and then to record "how many manifests change reading, and how many are newly refused", but a single arm cannot distinguish a manifest the new reader refuses from one the present reader already refuses. Measured: parsing all 14,221 manifests with the current `parse_manifest` yields 14,047 that parse and 174 that raise `ManifestParseError` today. A one-arm run therefore reports those 174 as "newly refused", overstating the rule's blast radius by that population, and cannot report "change reading" at all without a second reading to compare against.
